jobDescription.name: Your role
jobDescription.value: We build forecasting and pricing models for retailers and need a data scientist who writes clear Python, tests it, and explains results to non-experts. You will own experiments end to end, from the question to the dashboard, working with engineers and product managers in a small team in London. Requirements: Python, SQL, scikit-learn, statistics. Nice to have: Spark, dbt. We value careful testing and honest reporting of uncertainty.
